metadata.title: Retro Soul Portrait with Neon Script

retrievalProfile.description: A close-up profile portrait featuring warm, low-key lighting and vibrant neon-style script typography with magenta and cyan outlines.
triggerTerms: warm profile portrait on black background
excludeWhen: modern minimalist sans-serif typography is needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight profile shot of a person with warm, golden skin tones emerging from a deep black background, accented by hand-drawn neon-effect script in the corners.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm skin tones vs. deep black negative space
Soft facial gradients vs. sharp neon outlines
Diagonal placement of text in opposite corners
Profile gaze directed toward the right edge
coreInvariants: Magenta and cyan chromatic aberration effect on text
Tight cropping on the head and shoulders

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale profile headshot filling the center and right-center of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eye and the bridge of the nose, highlighted by soft key light.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the top-left script, down the bridge of the nose to the lips, ending at the bottom-right script.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy black negative space in the upper right and left margins.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm amber and golden skin highlights
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Magenta and electric blue neon outlines
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between skin and background; high saturation in the thin neon lines.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Cursive script with varying line weights
letterConstructionRules: Double-line outline effect to simulate neon tubes
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase letters are tightly connected with sharp exits
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single script style used for both artist name and title to maintain 80s cohesive branding.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 80s hand-drawn energy and brush-like flow.
Matches the double-line outline and glow treatment.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a close-up profile portrait of a person with warm skin tones against a solid black background, using soft side-lighting to define the facial features.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply custom cursive script in the top-left and bottom-right corners with a white core and thin magenta/cyan glowing outlines.

verificationChecks: Does the text have a neon glow effect?
Is the lighting on the face warm and soft?
Are the text outlines magenta and cyan?

mustRedesign: Identifiable facial features of the original subject
postGenerationChecks: Check for magenta/cyan color fringing on text
Confirm script is legible despite the glow
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait(Profile, Warm Light, Black BG) + Typography(Neon Script, Magenta/Cyan Outline, Diagonal Corners)
